analysis: Frozen-score threshold sweep, no fitting or new inference

method.score_direction: higher means more anomalous for every detector
method.thresholds: infinity plus descending unique observed scores
method.pr_summary: non-interpolated average precision (AP), not trapezoidal PR area
method.roc_summary: trapezoidal ROC AUC with tied-score handling
method.budget_selection: lowest observed threshold with false-positive count <= floor(normal_count*budget); IF_saved_rate uses the directly counted IF normal alerts; whole tied blocks, no interpolation or randomization
method.seeds: LLM seeds [42, 43, 44] analyzed separately; seed -1 identifies one fixed fitted ML model
method.plot: seed 42 and ML emphasized; other seeds thin/translucent; hollow markers saved Boolean/calibrated decisions; no-positive-prediction precision undefined and marker omitted

limitations: 360 normal windows overlap ML calibration population
Qwen thinking mode was selected after this comparison
adjacent windows and repeated seed predictions are dependent
budget thresholds selected on the reported cohort are descriptive, not independently validated deployment thresholds
precision depends on selected 67/427 positive fraction
scores are ranking signals, not calibrated probabilities
score threshold decisions are distinct from saved LLM Boolean decisions
matched alert caps need not yield equal attained normal-alert counts when scores tie
curves do not control differences in representation, model configuration, or hardware
